Plays a track of an audio CD in the original. There is no CD playback here.

```blitzbasic
Local ch = PlayCDTrack(2, 1)
If ch = 0 Then Print "No CD audio available" Else Print "Playing track 2"
WaitKey
```
@param track  The track number, counted from 1.
@param mode   1 plays the track once (the default), 2 repeats it and 3 plays on to the end of the disc.
@returns The channel of the track in the original. Always 0 here, as nothing is played.
@gap Always returns 0 and plays nothing. Use [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) with ripped tracks instead.
